steps.title: 設計日進料邊界：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Design-day influent boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 設計日進料邊界：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Design-day influent boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「設計日進料邊界」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at design-day influent boundary.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「設計日進料邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for design-day influent boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instructionEn:
Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for DO/flow/laboratory cross-check; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Action: Select the DO/flow/laboratory cross-check measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
